verifier_change.what: The gate now builds each theme from a programmatically cleaned seed: every fault the theme's live.faults catalogue declares enabled is disabled through the seed file's own faults: override channel (faults.catalogue merge), written as seed.clean.yaml under the output root (never in the repo). Disabled ids are recorded per theme as faults_disabled. Themes with no enabled faults build their stock seed.example.yaml untouched.
verifier_change.why: The plan's smoke criterion is 'zero job crashes on the clean seed'. sftp_vendor ships its fault catalogue enabled by design (flaky vendor feed is the theme's purpose), so the stock seed deterministically records 2 designed failed runs per 96h window (sftp_connection_reset retry, vendor_late_delivery arrival) and the stock-seed gate could never pass it. mainframe_batch's catalogue is also enabled; its stock-seed pass was draw luck. No existing theme file was modified.

notes: Common defect class across all 7 new themes, fixed per theme inside its own dbt macros: dbt-duckdb opens warehouse.duckdb so the catalog is named 'warehouse'; themes whose dbt models live in schema 'warehouse' and ref other warehouse-schema models rendered ambiguous two-part warehouse.<table>. The reference theme commerce_analytics never refs warehouse-schema models from model SQL, so it never tripped this. Each new theme now keeps the database qualifier exactly for catalog-colliding relations (safe: those are table materializations, which persist no query body; stored staging view bodies stay two-part and ATTACH-alias-safe).

A concurrent agent session (the other kimi window) edited settlement_clearing/workspace/dbt_project/macros/relations.sql at 04:54:19 while the theme's fix agent was debugging; the fix was independently root-caused to the same guard, empirically validated, and kept. No conflicting edits remain.
Executor note for gemini/Verifier-3: the initial world.build runs full `dbt build` (no selector), so every model and test in a theme must compile even if no scheduler job selects it.

Pre-existing git modifications under tasks/ and gateway/ predate this work; the 7 theme directories and verify_all_themes.py are new untracked paths, and no files outside them were edited by the theme-fix fleet.
